_meta.purpose: Ground truth for DS-3: consensus PRECISION measurement.
_meta.method: Labels are derived from authoritative-source knowledge, NOT from provider output. Circular labelling (picking the correct URL by looking at what providers returned) would make the measurement meaningless.
_meta.freeze_rule: This file must be written and committed BEFORE any provider is queried against it. Timestamps below record label authoring, not measurement.
_meta.fact_class_note: All entries are 'document' class: the query has an unambiguous canonical page. The measurement asks 'was the correct PAGE corroborated', not 'was the ANSWER correct'. That is a narrower claim and must be stated in the report.
